crossrefs.text: Why do You hide Your face and consider me as Your enemy?
How long will the wicked, O LORD, how long will the wicked exult?
They pour out arrogant words; all workers of iniquity boast.
How long, O LORD? Will You hide Yourself forever? Will Your wrath keep burning like fire?
Why have You forgotten us forever? Why have You forsaken us for so long?
O LORD God of Hosts, how long will Your anger smolder against the prayers of Your people?
My God, my God, why have You forsaken me? Why are You so far from saving me, so far from my words of groaning?
I cry out by day, O my God, but You do not answer, and by night, but I have no rest.

But now, for a brief moment, grace has come from the LORD our God to preserve for us a remnant and to give us a stake in His holy place. Even in our bondage, our God has given us new life and light to our eyes.
For You, O LORD, light my lamp; my God lights up my darkness.
in You, my God, I trust. Do not let me be put to shame; do not let my enemies exult over me.
Give ear to my words, O LORD; consider my groaning.
While they are flushed with heat, I will serve them a feast, and I will make them drunk so that they may revel; then they will fall asleep forever and never wake up, declares the LORD.
They will fight against you but will never overcome you, since I am with you to deliver you,” declares the LORD.
When the Canaanites and all who live in the land hear about this, they will surround us and wipe out our name from the earth. Then what will You do for Your great name?”

Jonathan, however, had not heard that his father had bound the people with the oath. So he reached out the end of the staff in his hand, dipped it into the honeycomb, and put his hand to his mouth; and his eyes brightened.
Surely God is my salvation; I will trust and not be afraid. For the LORD GOD is my strength and my song, and He also has become my salvation.”
keep yourselves in the love of God as you await the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ to bring you eternal life.
yet I will exult in the LORD; I will rejoice in the God of my salvation!
that I may declare all Your praises— that within the gates of Daughter Zion I may rejoice in Your salvation.
But I am like an olive tree flourishing in the house of God; I trust in the loving devotion of God forever and ever.
Return to your rest, O my soul, for the LORD has been good to you.
Be exalted, O LORD, in Your strength; we will sing and praise Your power.
Many are the sorrows of the wicked, but loving devotion surrounds him who trusts in the LORD.
